information.description:
Some Sanguinarios get specialized training thanks to their extreme loyalty, and this often results in more unique armament and cybernetic reinforcement. Their brutalistic methods are effective, even if they themselves believe they’re far more skilled than they really are. Nevertheless, they hit harder and more often than your average Gangoon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Valentinos).
information.notes:
Threat level: Elite Hardened Mook
Facedown #: 5
COM#: 12

Weapons:

  • Throwing Knife: ROF 2, 2d6. x2, Can be thrown as half of a ROF 2 Attack and still halve SP when thrown; thrown (built on the core Light Melee)
  • BigWave Foxtail [PQ] [Ironfake Variant Kyubi]: ROF 1, 6d6 (Drop Lowest) (not built: no item in this module or 0.92.4)

Armor:

  • Melee SP (head/body): 4/4

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
If damage dealt to target they are set alight. Target takes 2 damage to HP at end of their turn unless they use action to extinguish flames. Does not stack.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • +1 REF by 1 point for the duration
  • The user feels paranoid occasionally

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • -2 REF unless under the Primary Effect
  • GM will tell you when when you crave more Synthcoke. Roleplay accordingly.
